jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description_text:
The Basics:

Every organization is asking the same question right now: do I have the real-time visibility I need to stay secure and put AI to work safely? Tanium's autonomous, agentic platform - built on nearly two decades of real-time telemetry across 36 million+ endpoints worldwide - is the answer. That urgency is why Anthropic launched Project Glasswing, inviting Tanium and other companies like CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks, whose software underpins the world's critical infrastructure, to apply advanced AI models directly to their own codebases. Proven platform, frontier AI, real stakes -  that's the moment Tanium is in right now.

As our Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for some of our most competitive, highest-impact technical roles - backed by a best-in-class, AI-enabled stack (recruiting tools like Noon.AI and BrightHire, plus enterprise AI like Claude for everyday work) built to strip out busywork so you can spend your time on judgment calls, not admin. This role covers a variety of technical requisitions rather than one narrow lane, so it rewards curiosity and learning agility over deep specialization in any single domain. Our environment moves fast and priorities shift often. If that kind of ambiguity energizes you, you'll get broad exposure across teams and real room to build influence quickly.

jobs.title: Customer Facing Research Analyst
jobs.description_text:
Customer Facing Research Analyst

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.  In person attendance is required at least once per year for an onsite meeting. 

For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN LEVEL II

The role of Mechanical Technician is key to enabling the build of Neutron facilities to support a timely test and first launch campaign of the Neutron launch vehicle. This role will be part of a tight-knit team of technicians that will lead the build, integration, test, operation, and maintenance of both the Neutron launch vehicle and Neutron ground system assets.

ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

jobs.title: Capital Projects Analyst
jobs.description_text:
Vulcan Elements is manufacturing American rare-earth permanent magnets for a secure, resilient future. With a focus on national security and economic resiliency, we serve critical industries such as defense, aerospace, and automotive powering a high-technology future. Vulcan Elements is building a team of ambitious professionals committed to Mission Focus, Technical Excellence and Integrity. 

The Capital Projects Analyst will sit at the intersection of Accounting, Finance and Commercial Manufacturing stewarding the financial aspects of the build-out of Vulcan’s commercial manufacturing facility in Benson, NC, the production equipment that will operate at the facility, and all of the supporting capital infrastructure. This position is a critical part of Vulcan’s success as it will be in charge of Vulcan’s largest financial account: Property, Plant and Equipment.

The ideal candidate combines strong accounting foundations, with an analytical mindset, and an ability to act as the Accounting and Finance liaison to the Commercial Manufacturing team. You will own the processes, controls, and financial infrastructure required to manage a substantial capital project—from construction-in-progress and capitalization through asset commissioning and ongoing fixed-asset accounting.
